integrity: A symbolic proof from exact tetrahedral incidence and connected dual-face propagation; runnable independent finite double construction and coloring tests are supplied. Finite examples corroborate but do not substitute for the general proof.
limitations: The theorem requires a finite connected closed simplicial surface and a simplicial suspension; it gives no equivariant decomposition, no orbit-space theorem, and no result for surfaces with boundary. All higher-genus colorability tests use actual three-coloring, not degree parity.
title: A three-way connectivity law for doubles of suspended triangulated surfaces
